sources.excerpt: | Sony α6700 | `054c:0e78` in Remote Shoot; `054c:096f` before selection |
The body exposes no persistent USB connection-mode property and no advertised `USBConnectionModeRequest` (`0xf012`).

quirks.description: Enumerates as 054c:096f until USB Connection Mode is set to Remote Shoot (PC Remote) on the body, then as 054c:0e78. No PTP property persists the mode.
